name: dark-forest-local
description: Local sandbox deployment for testing the sponsored-transaction experience end to end. Addresses are read from the environment written by `sync-env-and-artifacts`, so this file never needs editing after a redeploy.

policy._comment_maxFeeWei: Deliberately generous for local testing — fake fee juice, and a low ceiling here would just produce confusing failures unrelated to the UX being tested.

_comment_maxUses: Only 5 per day on purpose: exhausting the allowance is one of the states worth actually looking at, and 30 would make that tedious to reach by hand.
_comment_allowedTargets: Resolved from the deploy environment. Same six player-facing contracts as mainnet; Admin and Config stay excluded so the local run exercises the real allowlist rather than a permissive one.
